description: Triggers whenever a WorkQ item is marked Done. Checks whether it's one of this plugin's payroll-correction items (the companion Corrections Workflow: Propose automation's own items, identified by its 'payroll-correction' label) and ignores anything else. For a revert-policy item, just confirms there's nothing further to do. For a next-pay-run or unscheduled-pay-run item, posts the exact adjustment to make (employee, pay run, earnings rate, hours) as a comment -- it does NOT write to Xero itself. Xero's Payslip API (needed to adjust a specific payslip's earnings lines) isn't built as a tool yet, so this automation confirms and gives precise manual instructions rather than guessing at a write it can't safely make.

flowIr.description: Fires when a WorkQ item is marked Done. If it's a payroll-correction item from the Propose automation, posts the confirmed next step as a comment -- manual revert acknowledgement, or exact manual payslip-adjustment instructions for next-pay-run/unscheduled-pay-run policies. Does not write to Xero.
flowIr.name: Corrections Workflow: Execute

outputs.description: One of: handled, no_todo_id, not_found, not_a_correction_item, no_correction_data.

nodes.summary: Reads the completed WorkQ item's full data, ignores it if it isn't one of this plugin's payroll-correction items, and otherwise posts the confirmed next step back onto the item -- a manual acknowledgement for revert, or precise manual adjustment instructions for next-pay-run/unscheduled-pay-run.
nodes.title: Handle a completed correction item
